audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers agree with each other but both disagree with the packet on four rows. Page: Volibear/Skill/Mordekaiser/Mordekaiser/Mordekaiser/Mordekaiser/Mordekaiser. Packet: Skill/Mordekaiser/Mordekaiser/Skill/Mordekaiser/Volibear/Volibear. Worse, the content whys[] captions already say the packet's answer — whys[0] 'it's even farm', whys[3] 'Even brawl window', whys[5] 'His tank spike flips it', whys[6] 'Full-tank Voli out-scales you outright' — so the chart hands Mordekaiser the first-item and two-item rows directly beside a caption saying Volibear wins them.
audit.why: 50.99% over 2006 games: Mordekaiser owns the level 2-3 window and the Realm at 6, and a full-tank Volibear reclaims the game on items. The page currently tells the player he wins the late game he actually loses.
audit.corrected: Both layers set to Skill / Mordekaiser / Mordekaiser / Skill / Mordekaiser / Volibear / Volibear as one atomic paired group, with ratings and the three contradicting phases[N].why lines rewritten.

audit.why: Four spikes[] present and correctly timed — Mordekaiser's level 1-3 Q+W window, Realm of Death at 6, first item before Volibear converts gold into resists, and Volibear's 2+ tank item takeover. The tldr's 'R him 1v1 as he falls off' contradicted this (Volibear does not fall off, he out-scales), which I fixed in the tldr rather than the spikes.
audit.corrected: tldr and winCon re-anchored to the real spike shape: your windows are 2-3 and 6, his are the tank items.

audit.whatIsWrong: All three flagged interactions were absent from the page and the cooldown block listed Thundering Smash twice as if it were two abilities, with no seconds on either. (a) Frenzied Maul (W) is a 5-SECOND cooldown that heals him on the repeat bite and applies on-hit effects — nothing on the page tells the player to buy Grievous Wounds, and report[8].t's item list has no anti-heal at all. (b) Thundering Smash (Q) stuns via an auto-attack RESET, so the tell is the wind-up, not a cast. (c) Frenzied Maul applying on-hit means his damage scales with attack speed off The Relentless Storm, so reading the trade off armour alone is wrong.
audit.why: A 5s heal that also carries on-hit is what decides every extended brawl, and the whole page's advice is to take extended brawls. Without anti-heal that plan loses.
audit.corrected: Rewrote breakdown.cooldowns to carry Thundering Smash's real 12s-to-10s cooldown and Frenzied Maul's 5s heal + on-hit; added Grievous Wounds to report[8].t and to tldr, winCon, report[0].t and report[5].t; put the auto-reset tell into dontsFull[0].d and the heal into dontsFull[1].d, both of which previously carried filler that did not match their own headings.
